description:

description:
The Waste Process Engineer is responsible for designing, optimising and managing processes and systems for the efficient handling, treatment, transformation and disposal of waste, including electronic waste (e-waste) and plastic waste, for an organisation. He/She is focused on minimising waste generation, exploring new technologies for enhancing waste management efficiency and material recovery, and recommending improved waste management systems and processes within an organisation. Based on life-cycle analyses and evaluation of current waste streams, systems and waste-to-resource initiatives, he will develop and implement new processes, ensuring compliance with environmental regulations. 

The Waste Process Engineer must be meticulous, with an eye for detail and have strong analytical and research skills to stay up to date on best practices and circular economy strategies related to waste management. He is also expected to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams to promote sustainable practices and contribute to the organisation’s goals in the Circular Economy.

cwf.critical_work_function: Design and develop waste treatment systems and processes
key_tasks: Analyse the performance of existing waste streams and treatment systems for waste materials to identify inefficiencies within the processes
Refine processes within waste treatment systems, with the aim of recovering more energy and materials whilst minimising emissions and waste
Conduct risk assessments to identify and mitigate environmental, safety and operational risks related to waste handling, processing, and disposal
Create process flow visualisations and detailed engineering specifications for new waste treatment systems, ensuring smooth integration into current operations and systems
Develop scalable, modular treatment systems, that can be easily expanded or moved based on demand and waste volumes

cwf.critical_work_function: Manage non-recyclable waste in compliance with regulations and minimise environmental impact
key_tasks: Assess the effectiveness of current disposal systems used to identify areas to reduce environmental hazard
Design waste disposal processes to convert non-recyclable waste into environmentally-friendly alternatives that promote energy recovery and minimise landfill use
Monitor disposal activities including the generation of by-products or waste from waste processes, to ensure compliance with environmental regulations and assess their long-term environmental impact
Introduce new or improved methods for waste disposal that minimise emissions and energy consumption
Create protocols to efficiently manage large or hazardous waste streams during emergency situations or peak production periods

cwf.critical_work_function: Research and integrate emerging sustainable technologies into waste management systems and operations
key_tasks: Research advancements in waste management technologies, evaluating their applicability to plastic waste and electronic waste (e-waste)
Evaluate the technical, economic, and environmental viability and impacts of integrating new technologies into waste management systems through lifecycle assessments
Develop system prototypes to test emerging technologies under operational conditions, optimising parameters related to temperature, pressure, and energy consumption
Recommend the suitable technologies for integration that maximise waste management efforts, securing buy-in from the relevant stakeholders
Develop integration plans to phase-in new waste management technologies into existing operations, ensuring a smooth transition and minimal disruption to current processes

Provide training and support to personnel on new waste management technology, ensuring proficiency in operating new equipment, understanding its capabilities, and troubleshooting potential issues during its use
Work closely with technology providers and other stakeholders to ensure that new waste management solutions are integrated effectively to maximise systems and operational potential

cwf.critical_work_function: Utilise data-driven methods to optimise waste treatment and disposal process to improve efficiency, compliance and sustainability
key_tasks: Conduct regular audits and inspections of waste management technology, preparing documentation that highlights compliance with environmental regulations and legislations
Establish measurable performance metrics to guide and track the progress of process optimisations for waste management
Set up real-time monitoring systems to track performance metrics and key environmental indicators throughout the waste treatment and disposal process
Analyse system and process performance data to identify inefficiencies and areas for improvement in existing processes
Refine waste processing based on insights from process performance data, optimising both efficiency and material recovery
Anticipate potential system failures to allow for proactive waste management system maintenance
Identify and resolve inefficiencies or breakdowns in waste treatment or disposal systems to ensure continuous operation and environmental compliance
Collaborate with various stakeholders to promote waste management initiatives, ensuring alignment with Circular Economy objectives

Procure specialised mechanical sorting and separation machines for the effective recovery of metals, plastics, and other materials from waste streams, leveraging machine learning algorithms to improve the accuracy and speed
Integrate chemical recycling into process flows to recover monomers and valuable chemicals from hard-to-recycle plastics
Employ suitable techniques to efficiently extract precious metals from electronic components in waste materials
Design protocols for hazardous material handling in waste recycling, managing toxic substances present in waste materials to prevent environmental contamination and ensure worker safety
